pages.title: Kirby Marx Balancing on His Jester Ball in His Classic Hat and Bow Tie Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Marx from Kirby balancing on his jester ball, wearing a two-pointed hat with dots and triangles above a large bow tie. His rounded shoes rest together on the ball's top. The coloring sheet features wide curved panels, simple outlines, and small contrasting costume patterns.

pages.title: Kirby Marx and Magolor Floating Together Above Planet Popstar Coloring Page
pages.description: Marx and Magolor float together above Planet Popstar in this printable coloring page, with Marx's small crystal wings spread beside Magolor's scarf and gear-shaped chest emblem. Stars surround the planet's broad five-pointed outline below them. Island contours and tiny mountains add detail inside the planet on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kirby Marx and Kirby Napping Together Beneath a Tree in Dream Land Coloring Page
pages.description: Marx and Kirby nap together beneath a tree in Dream Land in this printable coloring page, leaning side by side with closed eyes among grass and flowers. Marx's patterned jester hat and bow tie remain prominent beneath the large canopy. Broad foliage sections contrast with smaller petals and costume shapes.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Wobbling on His Ball as Kirby Gives Him a Hug Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Marx wobbling on his ball as Kirby gives him a hug, with small motion lines beside the curved ball panels and rounded shoes. Marx smiles beneath his dotted and triangular hat. The close composition leaves the background plain and highlights the embrace, bow tie, and large character shapes.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Visiting the Sleeping Kirby at His Round House Coloring Page
pages.description: Marx visits the sleeping Kirby at his round house in this printable coloring page, balancing on a star-patterned ball beside the open arched doorway and front steps. Kirby rests on a cushion inside beneath a round window. Door panels, flowers, and jester-hat patterns add small details across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Enjoying a Meal with Kirby and Waddle Dee Coloring Page
pages.description: Marx enjoys a meal with Kirby and Waddle Dee in this printable coloring page, sitting around sandwiches, a star-topped pastry, and a bowl of fruit. Kirby holds a small sandwich while Marx wears his patterned hat and bow tie. The coloring sheet adds compact food shapes to the broad characters and picnic setting.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Appearing at the Dream Palace as Kirby Summons a Dream Friend Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Marx appearing at the Dream Palace as Kirby summons a Dream Friend, lifting a heart beneath swirling trails and scattered stars. Tall decorated columns and arches surround the floating jester. The coloring sheet includes narrow architectural patterns beside the broad heart, character outlines, and curved platform.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Telling Kirby About the Sun and Moon Fighting Over Popstar Coloring Page
pages.description: Marx tells Kirby about the sun and moon fighting over Popstar in this printable coloring page, balancing on a star-patterned ball beneath the two frowning celestial figures. A jagged burst separates the sun and crescent moon. Stars and a small five-pointed Popstar fill the space above Kirby's surprised face.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Confronting Kirby Arriving Aboard the Starship Coloring Page
pages.description: Marx confronts Kirby arriving aboard the Starship in this printable coloring page, spreading his faceted crystal wings above a circular arena surrounded by floating rocks and tall crystals. Kirby faces him from the cockpit in the foreground. Large ship panels contrast with the many polygonal wing and landscape details.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Dropping Seeds That Sprout Into Thorny Vines Around Kirby Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Marx dropping seeds that sprout into thorny vines around Kirby, hovering above two tall curling stems with pointed thorns and leaves. Several seeds fall between the characters. Faceted wing ornaments and patterned hat panels add small details beside the larger vines and Kirby's round outline.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Bursting From the Ground with Shadow Uppercut Coloring Page
pages.description: Marx bursts from the ground with Shadow Uppercut in this printable coloring page, rising above a broken crater with crystal wings spread and both shoes lifted forward. Curved upward trails and flying stones show the motion. Irregular rubble shapes and patterned hat sections add details around the large central figure.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Firing a Spreading Barrage of Arrows From His Winged Body Coloring Page
pages.description: Marx fires a spreading barrage of arrows from his winged body in this printable coloring page, hovering beneath tall wing frames hung with faceted crystal panels. Long pointed arrows fan outward toward the ground. The coloring sheet combines broad arrow interiors with smaller hat patterns, bow folds, and crystal borders.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Teleporting Away as Kirby Launches a Star Projectile Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Marx teleporting away as Kirby launches a star projectile, with a jagged aura and small sparkles surrounding Marx's winged figure. Kirby stands below with his mouth open toward the speeding star. The large projectile and curved ground lines leave spacious areas around the finer costume details.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Rolling Across Water on His Ball with Kirby Riding Piggyback Coloring Page
pages.description: Marx rolls across water on his ball with Kirby riding piggyback in this printable coloring page, balancing above splashes and ripples beside a distant low shoreline. Kirby holds onto Marx's patterned hat from behind. Curved ball panels provide wide sections, while droplets and costume patterns add smaller shapes.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Rushing Into Whispy Woods with His Crystal Wings Coloring Page
pages.description: Marx rushes into Whispy Woods with his crystal wings in this printable coloring page, flying toward the tree's startled face as apples fall beside the trunk. Speed lines trail behind Marx and his patterned hat. The coloring sheet pairs broad tree foliage and roots with smaller wing facets, apples, and grass.

pages.title: Kirby Marx and Chilly Creating an Icy Jester Ball with Blizzard Power Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Marx and Chilly creating an icy jester ball with Blizzard Power, with Chilly blowing curled gusts and snowflakes toward the decorated ball. Angular ice crystals form around its edge. Stars, dots, hat patterns, and Chilly's scarf give the coloring sheet several kinds of enclosed detail.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Floating Upward on a Wind-powered Bluster Jester Ball Beside Birdon Coloring Page
pages.description: Marx floats upward on a wind-powered Bluster Jester Ball beside Birdon in this printable coloring page, with broad spiraling gusts wrapping around the star-patterned ball. Birdon flaps beside Marx's shoulder with wings spread. The coloring sheet uses large curved wind sections alongside small feathers, hat patterns, and bow details.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Firing Zap Lightning Arrows Alongside Plugg Coloring Page
pages.description: Marx fires Zap lightning arrows alongside Plugg in this printable coloring page, spreading crystal-hung wings as jagged bolts fan outward from the airborne jester's body. Plugg stands below with sparks around its two prongs. The coloring sheet pairs angular electrical shapes with smaller crystal facets and patterned hat panels.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Pulling a Hanging Switch with the Tip of His Jester Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Marx pulling a hanging switch with the tip of his jester hat, looking upward from a round platform beneath the suspended ring. One long hat point hooks through the ring, while the other droops sideways. Broad face and platform areas surround the smaller costume patterns.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Piloting the Friend Star with Kirby and Two Dream Friends Coloring Page
pages.description: Marx pilots the Friend Star with Kirby and two Dream Friends in this printable coloring page, riding at the front while Magolor and Bandana Waddle Dee gather behind him. A star emblem marks the vehicle's nose, with circular openings along its sides. Costume patterns and scattered stars add smaller coloring sections.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Cheering From the Audience as Kirby Celebrates Becoming a Master Coloring Page
pages.description: Marx cheers from the audience as Kirby celebrates becoming a master in this printable coloring page, balancing on a star-patterned ball beneath the raised presentation platform. Kirby wears a large star-centered crown beside two Waddle Dees. Draped fabric, hat patterns, and curved seating lines provide distinct sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Joining Gooey, Rick, Kine and Coo After a Dream Friend Adventure Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Marx joining Gooey, Rick, Kine, and Coo after a Dream Friend adventure, gathered beside a pond, leafy branch, and grassy bank. Marx balances on a star-marked ball in front, while Coo perches overhead and Kine sits in the water. The varied characters create clearly separated coloring areas.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Driving the Bull Tank as Three Broom Hatters Flee Coloring Page
pages.description: Marx drives the Bull Tank as three Broom Hatters flee in this printable coloring page, rising from the open hatch above the tank's horns and broad tracked wheels. Each fleeing character carries a broom beneath a pointed hat. Dust clouds, tread segments, and hat patterns add detail to the chase scene.

pages.title: Kirby Marx in Candy Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Marx visits a candy village in this printable coloring page, wearing a patterned jester hat and raising a star wand among sweet-shaped houses, lollipops, and candy canes. Rounded stepping stones wind between the buildings. Spiral sweets, roof tiles, and small windows give the coloring sheet many enclosed decorative areas.

pages.title: Kirby Marx in Chocolate Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Marx appear in a chocolate meadow in this printable coloring page, with Kirby holding a chocolate bar beside Marx's wand and small spread wings. Candy-covered trees, iced hills, and square chocolate stepping stones fill the setting. The coloring sheet mixes large landscape shapes with compact sweet and costume details.

pages.title: Kirby Marx in Flower Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kirby and Marx in a flower meadow, standing among daisies, tall blossoms, leafy stems, and gently rolling hills with scattered trees. Marx wears a patterned jester hat and spreads small wings beside Kirby. The foreground flowers supply fine details below the broad character and hill shapes.

pages.title: Kirby Marx in Sky Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Marx float over a sky garden in this printable coloring page, above a winding path bordered by star-patterned bushes, flowers, and pointed leaves. Small buildings rest on distant cloud platforms. Marx's spread wings and patterned hat add character details, while the rounded clouds and garden island offer wider spaces.

pages.title: Kirby Marx in King Dedede's Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Marx appears at King Dedede's castle in this printable coloring page, wearing a two-pointed patterned hat beside a winding path leading to the large arched gate. Flags and a shield display DDD lettering above the towers. Star decorations, crenellations, and small windows add architectural details within the rounded rectangular border.

pages.title: Kirby Marx in Candy Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Kirby and Marx in a candy kingdom, following a stone path toward a castle surrounded by spiral lollipops and a cupcake-shaped house. Marx spreads small wings beneath his dotted hat. Striped towers, gumdrop-like stones, and candy canes create many patterned sections throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kirby Marx Above the Clouds Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Marx float above the clouds in this printable coloring page, beneath scattered stars and a smiling crescent moon, with a dotted ball hanging below Marx. Small wings extend from Marx's sides under his star-patterned hat. Overlapping cloud banks leave large rounded areas across the lower coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kirby Marx in Popstar Plains Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kirby and Marx above the Popstar plains, with Marx spreading pointed wings and a heart-tipped tail over a winding countryside path. A smiling hill, leafy trees, and foreground flowers complete the landscape. Large cloud borders contrast with the smaller costume patterns and plant details.

pages.title: Kirby Marx in Crystal Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Marx explore a crystal cave in this printable coloring page, floating among tall faceted formations, hanging crystals, and scattered angular stones on the ground. Marx spreads small feathered wings beside Kirby. The coloring sheet offers many straight-edged crystal panels around the rounded characters and patterned jester hat.

pages.title: Kirby Marx in Treasure Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Marx visit a treasure cave in this printable coloring page, with Kirby riding a gem-filled minecart beneath Marx's spread wings and star-patterned jester hat. Tracks cross the rocky floor beside an open chest, coins, and a crown. The coloring sheet combines mechanical cart details with small jewelry and cave shapes.

pages.title: Kirby Marx in Cookie Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Kirby and Marx in a cookie forest, following a winding path between patterned treetops, gingerbread figures, and a small distant cottage. Marx carries a star wand beside Kirby. Cookie spots, stars, and individual leaves add enclosed details around the broad tree trunks and central path.

pages.title: Kirby Marx in Frozen Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: Marx balances on his ball in a frozen valley in this printable coloring page, raising one foot between pointed ice formations and fir trees below snow-capped mountains. A winding frozen-looking channel crosses the foreground. Dots on the ball and hat add small repeated shapes beside the large snowy landscape sections.

pages.title: Kirby Marx in Dream Land Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Marx appear in a Dream Land meadow in this printable coloring page, hovering above flowers and grass while a face-bearing tree stands on a distant hill. Marx spreads feathered wings beneath his patterned cap. A partial rectangular frame contains the foreground, where flower petals and small bushes add finer details.
